einzeiler: A man's eyes suddenly project halfway across the world to a remote Antarctic island.
kurzfassung: Following a laboratory lightning strike, a scientist named Sidney Davidson finds himself completely blind to his immediate surroundings while vividly seeing a remote, penguin-filled island halfway across the world. For weeks, he navigates life in this jarring dual reality until his normal vision gradually returns. Years later, a chance encounter with a naval officer proves that the impossible distant landscape Davidson saw was entirely real.
stichpunkte: Sidney Davidson experiences a bizarre seizure in a laboratory during a thunderstorm, shattering an electrometer.
He becomes entirely blind to his physical surroundings in London while seeing an unfamiliar, rocky beach with penguins and a ship.
Professor Wade suggests this is an unprecedented hallucination, while Davidson describes feeling like he is walking through empty space.
The strange condition lasts for three weeks, leaving Davidson completely helpless and dependent on others for basic care.
During an outdoor trip, Davidson experiences a terrifying vision of sinking deep into a dark ocean filled with glowing marine life and a wrecked ship.
His normal vision slowly returns as translucent gaps form in his phantom field of view, eventually merging until he can see normally again.
Two years later, a visiting naval officer shows a photograph of a ship that Davidson immediately recognizes as the one from his vision.
Verification reveals the ship was indeed near Antipodes Island during a storm on the exact day of Davidson's seizure, confirming he witnessed a real distant location.
beschreibung:
Sidney Davidson can hear his friends in England, feel the furniture beneath his hands, and yet his eyes insist he is somewhere impossibly far away. As the vision refuses to fade, one question becomes harder to dismiss: what if the impossible scene before him is not a dream at all? The Remarkable Case of Davidson’s Eyes by H. G. Wells. That’s next on The Lost Sci-Fi Podcast.

Today’s story was first published in the Pall Mall Budget which was a weekly British magazine published in London and served as a weekly digest of articles and news summaries collected from its parent evening newspaper, the Pall Mall Gazette.

Like many of the stories written by H. G. Wells it has been reprinted more than a hundred times.

Let’s go back to Thursday March 28th, 1895 and discover, The Remarkable Case of Davidson’s Eyes by H. G. Wells…

Next on The Lost Sci-Fi Podcast, Deep in the Brazilian jungle, a terrified family has found a way to bargain with something no human being was meant to bargain with. When an American naturalist realizes who—or what—is demanding payment, he begins to understand how easily an army of tiny creatures could become something far more dangerous. Doomsday Deferred by Murray Leinster.
